Classes and interfaces

CombinedPlayerPersonaAdapter
Adapter for mudlib player objects that collapse several JVMud concepts into one object.
InstanceHost
Interactive operations on one hosted mudlib, independent of its player transport.
InstancePersona
Active server-side binding for one telnet player's current mudlib Persona.
MudInstance
Runtime and serialized world operations for one independently hosted mudlib.
MudlibBoot
Boots one mudlib from an explicit JVMud manifest into an engine-owned world runtime.
MudlibBootProgress
Receives host-visible progress events while a mudlib is being booted.
MudlibBootProgress.PreloadKind
Identifies which startup declaration requested a preload.
MudlibBootResult
Immutable result of booting one explicitly configured mudlib into a native world runtime.
MudlibSpec
Explicit mudlib root and relative manifest path supplied to the engine.
MudlibWorker
Private worker JVM entry point.
StartupObjectLoadTrace
Worker-side compilation and load diagnostics for a single mudlib startup.
